audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart read Vayne in all seven rows of both layers (phases[0..6].side and win[0..6]) at 7/10, while every line of prose on both layers says Aatrox owns levels 1 through 6 and Vayne only flips on items. The aatrox-side mirror audit already established Aatrox owns the early rows.
audit.why: 49.37% over 1738 games with prose describing an Aatrox-favoured early game; the packet levelChart is Aatrox x5 then Vayne x2.
audit.corrected: phases[0..4].side and win[0..4] = Aatrox at 3/10; rows 5 and 6 (First item, 2+ items) stay Vayne at 7/10, matching the packet chart, whys[5]/whys[6] and spikes[2].

audit.why: Spikes already name the real windows: Aatrox Q1-Q2-Q3 at 3-5, World Ender (R) at 6, Vayne's Blade of the Ruined King first item, 2+ items with Final Hour. Cooldown numbers added to phases[2] and phases[3] why-text (Infernal Chains 20s at rank 1, The Darkin Blade 8s at rank 4).
audit.corrected: Aatrox: World Ender 120/100/80s at 6, Infernal Chains 20/18/16/14/12s, The Darkin Blade 14/12/10/8/6s. Vayne: Condemn 20s at rank 1, Final Hour 100/85/70s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two applicable interactions were absent: Aatrox's sustain stack (Deathbringer Stance P, Umbral Dash E passive heal, World Ender R healing amp) making Grievous Wounds timing decisive, and the fact that his commit opens on a Deathbringer Stance auto-reset rather than an ability cast. dosFull[2].d and dontsFull[1].d also carried text unrelated to their own titles.
audit.why: Silver Bolts is true damage so his armour does not help, but his healing directly fights Vayne's chip pattern — Executioner's Calling timing is the real lever. The auto-reset wind-up is the visual tell for stepping back.
audit.corrected: dosFull[2].d -> Silver Bolts third hit is true damage, buy Executioner's early. dontsFull[1].d -> Deathbringer Stance resets his auto, back off on the wind-up.

audit.why: packet suspectNames flags "World Ender's" in spikes[3].text as a probable wrong name. This is a FALSE POSITIVE — the matcher trips on the possessive; World Ender is the correct Riot name for Aatrox's R. No edit made.

edits.before: Kite with autos and never let him touch you. Identify how Aatrox contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: His Q outranges your auto and cleaves the wave, so he owns level 1 — last-hit from max range, give up CS you cannot reach.

edits.before: Q tumble resets make your spacing untouchable. Only take the trade when Aatrox's World Ender is down.
edits.after: At 2 his Q1-Q2 chain plus Deathbringer Stance healing wins any short trade — Tumble to dodge, not to trade.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Aatrox must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Infernal Chains (W) drags you back into a full Q combo at 3 — its 20s cooldown at rank 1 is your only safe walk-up window.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around World Ender's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: His cooldowns fall low enough to zone you off CS — The Darkin Blade is 8s at rank 4. Farm from range and wait on your first item.

edits.before: Final Hour stealth-tumbles break every engage pattern onto you. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Aatrox's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: World Ender at 6 hands him healing and stats to walk you down; Final Hour hides your Tumble but does not out-damage his sustain yet.

edits.before: Aatrox wastes World Ender — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Silver Bolts' third hit is true damage; buy Executioner's early.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Deathbringer Stance resets his auto — back off on the wind-up.

notes: Chart rows 0-4 flipped to Aatrox in matched full/content pairs; rows 5-6 left Vayne to match packet.levelChart, whys[5]/[6] and spikes[2] (Blade of the Ruined King flip).
